protocol.latent_state: Used only by environment dynamics, scoring, and the exact oracle; never passed to either controller.
protocol.observable_state: Only the state-aware condition receives a bounded projection: verification, temporal status, provenance count, conflicts, composition progress, prior actions/outcomes, and budget.
protocol.shared_policy_substrate: Both conditions are subject to the same hidden deterministic safety policy; STATE_BLIND is not policy-free.

scope: Frozen deterministic I3.3 development benchmark; no model-controller result.
